intent: new species in user-confirmed two-pattern world; direct refs are style only

tool_arguments.prompt:
Create ONE new small BACKGROUND ANIMAL PROP for the Num-Num Numbers illustrated world. Use the supplied fairy-pitta (ヤイロチョウ) as the direct STYLE AND SIMPLIFICATION REFERENCE: rounded toy-like picture-book silhouette, short compact body, simple small warm-brown dot eye, warm brown clear hand-drawn contour, gently textured watercolor/gouache with delicate paper grain, simplified readable species color blocks and a calm friendly expression. Apply this same simplified bird-prop treatment to the requested species; it must look like a small cast-world decoration, not a realistic zoological study or detailed natural-history painting. This is intentionally the bird-like PROP pattern rather than the upright speaking-character pattern. Keep the animal's essential recognizable shape, but simplify feathers/scales/fur/fins and exaggerate roundness and friendliness. Exactly one complete subject, a clean side or slight three-quarter pose, all extremities fully inside a square canvas with generous margins. Genuine transparent RGBA background. No habitat, water, rocks, grass, ground/shadow disc, clothing, hats, text, labels, watermarks or extra subjects. No photo-real textures, glossy 3D, complex shading or sharp predatory teeth. Deliver a high-resolution single PNG that will usually be displayed small, around200–300px reference height or width as appropriate.
